confidence: medium. Five sources, but 3 of 5 are Halloween-specific and sales-based, which may under-rank Snickers, Twix and Kit Kat (Snickers is the most-recognized bar at 94% awareness per Statista, but awareness is not popularity). All are top-5 to top-10 lists, so ranks 10-19 are tightly bunched (10.0-11.0) and nearly interchangeable. The Ranker candy lists (62.6K voters, 177 items) exist but returned 401, so they are not cited.
